usage: usda-data [-h] [--version]
                 {list-datasets,sync,validate,calendar,fetch} ...

Versioned USDA downloads and SQL-ready exports

positional arguments:
  {list-datasets,sync,validate,calendar,fetch}
    list-datasets       List all seven frozen dataset IDs
    sync                Refresh every configured partition; resume failed jobs
                        and publish only complete runs
    validate            Verify selected CSV schemas, keys, row counts and
                        content hashes
    calendar            Show saved official publication events with precision
                        and stale-calendar labels
    fetch               Fetch a supported dataset and atomically publish a
                        complete CSV

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

checks.python_example:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from usda_data.schema import Schema

root = Path("data/exports/datasets")
manifest = json.loads((root / "complete.latest.json").read_text())
selected = manifest["exports"]["wasde"]
schema = Schema.load(root / selected["schema_path"])
chunk = next(schema.read_csv_chunks(root / selected["csv_path"], chunk_size=1000))
assert len(chunk) == 1000
assert chunk["WasdeNumber"].map(type).eq(str).all()
